description: [h1]Remastered Framework Survival[/h1]A Survival Custom Game and modder framework: bot hijack gameplay plus store / quest hooks for Blocks & Parts mods.[b]Key Features[/b][list][*]Host /setup, player /menu, host /gensettings (MAIN / FEATURES / STREAMERS / DISCORD)[*]Custom menus, expanded inventory, advanced farming, and host dev tools[*]Bot hijack - Hack/Control/Infection beacons (Hideout 20/50/120 Farmers with RFS Beacons B&P); chain convert; /unhijack; beacon E Orders: Rest/Defend, Hay Farm, Tote Collect, Waterbot Collect Oil[*][b]Map[/b] - Always-on MiniMap HUD (upper-left). Research/craft Nutt's GPS (Metal Block + Circuit + Component Kit + Glass), then LMB to open the full atlas. Terrain/atlas map by [b]Nutt[/b] (Steam Workshop World Map [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3780282057]3780282057[/url]). Subscribe; do not enable as a world mod. Weapon ammo stays on the HUD[*]Anchor / tile loaders (WARNING: performance impact if loading many tiles)[*]Faster loads / quieter console (recipe scan fix)[*]Store hooks - craftbot.json, hideout_trades.json, mininghub_trades.json via ModDatabase[*]Unlockable schematic progression (not a vault-tree editor)[*]RfsQuest API around Survival QuestManager (see MODDER_API.txt)[*]frameworkOnly flag in rfs_settings.json for baseline / framework-only mode[/list][b]Install[/b][list][*]Subscribe to ModDatabase (keep installed; do not enable as a world mod)[*]Subscribe to [b]World Map[/b] by Nutt (keep installed; do not enable as a world mod)[*]Create a new world with [b]Remastered Framework Survival[/b][*]Enable your Blocks & Parts mods (e.g. Intelligentia, RFS Beacons)[/list][b]Links[/b] GitHub: https://github.com/zernon916/Remastered-Framework-Systems - Discord: https://discord.gg/DfjDMRx9ab[b]Discord / Streamer companion (optional)[/b]In-game Streamer votes use %USER_DATA%/rfs_discord_bridge file drops. The Discord/Streamer companion is not bundled - clone discord-bridge/ from GitHub (https://github.com/zernon916/Remastered-Framework-Systems) and run separately; community Discord: https://discord.gg/DfjDMRx9ab[b]For mod authors[/b]See AUTHOR_GUIDE.txt and MODDER_API.txt in the mod folder.[b]Credits[/b] MiniMap and atlas terrain by [b]Nutt[/b] (Steam Workshop [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3780282057]World Map 3780282057[/url]). Subscribe to World Map; do not enable it as a world mod. [b]Author:[/b] Zernon916
